_comment: The `vendor` group takes `vendor.js`, which three entries load (`a`, `b` and `other.js`), but not `peer.js`, which two entries load, so `peer.js` stays in the chunk of `a` and `b`. A fold of `shared.js` into that chunk would make it and `vendor` import each other, and `vendor.js` would read `token` before `shared.js` declares it, so `shared.js` stays a file.
